en.t: Third conditional: If I had known
en.g: Welcome to B2! Imagine a different past with the third conditional.
p: Form: If + had + past participle, would have + past participle: If I had left earlier, I wouldn't have missed the train.
It's about the past and it didn't happen: If we had booked (we didn't), we would have got a table (we didn't).
Swap would for could or might for less certainty: If she had studied, she might have passed. Spoken: I'd've, wouldn't've.
en.q: Think of a small moment that changed your life. What would have happened if things had gone differently?
en.c: Write three third conditional sentences about your past: one lucky moment, one mistake and one surprise.

de.t: Third conditional: If I had known
de.g: Willkommen bei B2! Mit dem third conditional stellst du dir eine andere Vergangenheit vor.
p: Form: If + had + Partizip, would have + Partizip: If I had left earlier, I wouldn't have missed the train.
Es geht um die Vergangenheit, und es ist nicht passiert: If we had booked (haben wir nicht), we would have got a table.
Could oder might statt would für weniger Sicherheit: If she had studied, she might have passed. Gesprochen: I'd've.
de.q: Denk an einen kleinen Moment, der dein Leben verändert hat. Was wäre passiert, wenn es anders gelaufen wäre?
de.c: Schreib drei Sätze im third conditional über deine Vergangenheit: ein Glücksmoment, ein Fehler und eine Überraschung.

es.t: Third conditional: If I had known
es.g: ¡Bienvenido al B2! Imagina un pasado distinto con el third conditional.
p: Forma: If + had + participio, would have + participio: If I had left earlier, I wouldn't have missed the train.
Habla del pasado y de algo que no pasó: If we had booked (no reservamos), we would have got a table (no la tuvimos).
Cambia would por could o might para expresar menos certeza: If she had studied, she might have passed. Oral: I'd've.
es.q: Piensa en un pequeño momento que cambió tu vida. ¿Qué habría pasado si las cosas hubieran ido de otra manera?
es.c: Escribe tres frases en third conditional sobre tu pasado: un momento de suerte, un error y una sorpresa.

fr.t: Third conditional: If I had known
fr.g: Bienvenue au B2 ! Imagine un passé différent avec le third conditional.
p: Forme : If + had + participe, would have + participe : If I had left earlier, I wouldn't have missed the train.
C'est le passé et ça n'est pas arrivé : If we had booked (on ne l'a pas fait), we would have got a table.
Could ou might à la place de would pour moins de certitude : If she had studied, she might have passed. À l'oral : I'd've.
fr.q: Pense à un petit moment qui a changé ta vie. Que se serait-il passé si les choses avaient tourné autrement ?
fr.c: Écris trois phrases au third conditional sur ton passé : un coup de chance, une erreur et une surprise.

it.t: Third conditional: If I had known
it.g: Benvenuto al B2! Immagina un passato diverso con il third conditional.
p: Forma: If + had + participio, would have + participio: If I had left earlier, I wouldn't have missed the train.
Parla del passato e di qualcosa che non è successo: If we had booked (non l'abbiamo fatto), we would have got a table.
Usa could o might al posto di would per meno certezza: If she had studied, she might have passed. Parlato: I'd've.
it.q: Pensa a un piccolo momento che ti ha cambiato la vita. Cosa sarebbe successo se fosse andata diversamente?
it.c: Scrivi tre frasi al third conditional sul tuo passato: un colpo di fortuna, un errore e una sorpresa.

pt.t: Third conditional: If I had known

p: Forma: If + had + particípio, would have + particípio: If I had left earlier, I wouldn't have missed the train.
Fala do passado e de algo que não aconteceu: If we had booked (não reservámos), we would have got a table.
Troca would por could ou might para menos certeza: If she had studied, she might have passed. Na fala: I'd've.
pt.q: Pensa num pequeno momento que mudou a tua vida. O que teria acontecido se as coisas tivessem corrido de outra forma?
pt.c: Escreve três frases no third conditional sobre o teu passado: um momento de sorte, um erro e uma surpresa.

pt_BR.t: Third conditional: If I had known

en.g: Mix past and present in one sentence with mixed conditionals.
p: Past cause, present result: If I had studied medicine (past), I would be a doctor now (present).
Present cause, past result: If I were taller (always true), I would have joined the team (past).
Time words help: now, today, still, by now. If I hadn't met her, I wouldn't be so happy today.
en.q: What's one past decision that shapes your life today? Make a mixed conditional about it.
en.c: Write two mixed conditionals about yourself: one past → present and one present → past.

de.g: Mit gemischten Bedingungssätzen verbindest du Vergangenheit und Gegenwart in einem Satz.
p: Ursache in der Vergangenheit, Folge jetzt: If I had studied medicine (damals), I would be a doctor now (heute).
Ursache in der Gegenwart, Folge damals: If I were taller (immer wahr), I would have joined the team (damals).
Zeitwörter helfen: now, today, still, by now. If I hadn't met her, I wouldn't be so happy today.
de.q: Welche frühere Entscheidung prägt dein Leben heute? Bilde einen gemischten Bedingungssatz dazu.
de.c: Schreib zwei gemischte Bedingungssätze über dich: einen Vergangenheit → Gegenwart und einen Gegenwart → Vergangenheit.

es.g: Mezcla pasado y presente en una frase con los condicionales mixtos.
p: Causa pasada, resultado presente: If I had studied medicine (pasado), I would be a doctor now (presente).
Causa presente, resultado pasado: If I were taller (siempre cierto), I would have joined the team (pasado).
Las palabras de tiempo ayudan: now, today, still, by now. If I hadn't met her, I wouldn't be so happy today.
es.q: ¿Qué decisión pasada marca tu vida hoy? Haz un condicional mixto sobre ella.
es.c: Escribe dos condicionales mixtos sobre ti: uno pasado → presente y otro presente → pasado.

fr.g: Mélange passé et présent dans une même phrase avec les conditionnelles mixtes.
p: Cause passée, résultat présent : If I had studied medicine (passé), I would be a doctor now (présent).
Cause présente, résultat passé : If I were taller (toujours vrai), I would have joined the team (passé).
Les mots de temps aident : now, today, still, by now. If I hadn't met her, I wouldn't be so happy today.
fr.q: Quelle décision passée influence ta vie aujourd'hui ? Fais une conditionnelle mixte à ce sujet.
fr.c: Écris deux conditionnelles mixtes sur toi : une passé → présent et une présent → passé.

it.g: Mescola passato e presente in una frase con i periodi ipotetici misti.
p: Causa passata, risultato presente: If I had studied medicine (passato), I would be a doctor now (presente).
Causa presente, risultato passato: If I were taller (sempre vero), I would have joined the team (passato).
Le parole di tempo aiutano: now, today, still, by now. If I hadn't met her, I wouldn't be so happy today.
it.q: Quale decisione del passato influenza la tua vita di oggi? Crea un periodo ipotetico misto.
it.c: Scrivi due periodi ipotetici misti su di te: uno passato → presente e uno presente → passato.

pt.g: Mistura passado e presente numa só frase com as condicionais mistas.
p: Causa passada, resultado presente: If I had studied medicine (passado), I would be a doctor now (presente).
Causa presente, resultado passado: If I were taller (sempre verdade), I would have joined the team (passado).
As palavras de tempo ajudam: now, today, still, by now. If I hadn't met her, I wouldn't be so happy today.
pt.q: Que decisão do passado marca a tua vida hoje? Faz uma condicional mista sobre ela.
pt.c: Escreve duas condicionais mistas sobre ti: uma passado → presente e outra presente → passado.

pt_BR.g: Misture passado e presente numa só frase com as condicionais mistas.
p: Causa passada, resultado presente: If I had studied medicine (passado), I would be a doctor now (presente).
Causa presente, resultado passado: If I were taller (sempre verdade), I would have joined the team (passado).
Palavras de tempo ajudam: now, today, still, by now. If I hadn't met her, I wouldn't be so happy today.
pt_BR.q: Que decisão do passado marca a sua vida hoje? Faça uma condicional mista sobre ela.
pt_BR.c: Escreva duas condicionais mistas sobre você: uma passado → presente e outra presente → passado.

target.gram: Mixed: past cause → present result: If + past perfect, would + verb. Present fact → past result: If + past simple, would have + pp.

en.t: Regrets: I wish I had, if only
en.g: Talk about past regrets with I wish I had and If only I had.
p: Past regret: I wish + past perfect: I wish I had studied harder. I wish I hadn't said that.
If only is stronger and more emotional: If only I had listened to you! If only we had left earlier!
Compare: I wish I knew (present: I don't know now) vs I wish I had known (past: I didn't know then).
en.q: Is there something small you wish you had done differently? What would you do now?
en.c: Write three wishes: one past regret with I wish I had, one with If only and one about the present with I wish I knew/were.

de.t: Regrets: I wish I had, if only
de.g: Du sprichst über Bedauern in der Vergangenheit mit I wish I had und If only I had.
p: Bedauern über Vergangenes: I wish + past perfect: I wish I had studied harder. I wish I hadn't said that.
If only ist stärker und emotionaler: If only I had listened to you! If only we had left earlier!
Vergleich: I wish I knew (jetzt weiß ich es nicht) vs. I wish I had known (damals wusste ich es nicht).
de.q: Gibt es etwas Kleines, das du gern anders gemacht hättest? Was würdest du heute tun?
de.c: Schreib drei Wünsche: ein Bedauern mit I wish I had, einen Satz mit If only und einen zur Gegenwart mit I wish I knew/were.

es.t: Regrets: I wish I had, if only
es.g: Habla de arrepentimientos del pasado con I wish I had e If only I had.
p: Lamento del pasado: I wish + past perfect: I wish I had studied harder. I wish I hadn't said that.
If only es más fuerte y emotivo: If only I had listened to you! If only we had left earlier!
Compara: I wish I knew (ahora no lo sé) con I wish I had known (entonces no lo sabía).
es.q: ¿Hay algo pequeño que te gustaría haber hecho de otra manera? ¿Qué harías ahora?
es.c: Escribe tres deseos: un lamento con I wish I had, uno con If only y uno sobre el presente con I wish I knew/were.

fr.q: Y a-t-il une petite chose que tu aurais aimé faire autrement ? Que ferais-tu maintenant ?
fr.c: Écris trois souhaits : un regret avec I wish I had, un avec If only et un sur le présent avec I wish I knew/were.

it.q: C'è una piccola cosa che avresti voluto fare diversamente? Cosa faresti adesso?
it.c: Scrivi tre desideri: un rimpianto con I wish I had, uno con If only e uno sul presente con I wish I knew/were.

en.t: Should have and ought to have
en.g: Criticise or regret past actions with should have and ought to have.
p: Regret: I should have left earlier (I didn't). Criticism: You shouldn't have shouted (you did).
Ought to have means the same but is more formal: We ought to have booked in advance.
Could have for missed chances or mild complaints: You could have asked me! Also the polite thanks: Oh, you shouldn't have!
en.q: Think of a time something went wrong. What should you have done differently?
en.c: Write about a small disaster (late, lost, forgotten) in four sentences with should have, shouldn't have and could have.

de.t: Should have and ought to have
de.g: Du kritisierst oder bedauerst vergangene Handlungen mit should have und ought to have.
p: Bedauern: I should have left earlier (habe ich nicht). Kritik: You shouldn't have shouted (hast du aber).
Ought to have bedeutet dasselbe, klingt aber formeller: We ought to have booked in advance.
Could have für verpasste Chancen oder sanfte Vorwürfe: You could have asked me! Und als Dank: Oh, you shouldn't have!
de.q: Denk an eine Situation, in der etwas schiefging. Was hättest du anders machen sollen?
de.c: Schreib über ein kleines Missgeschick (zu spät, verloren, vergessen) in vier Sätzen mit should have, shouldn't have und could have.

es.t: Should have and ought to have

p: Lamento: I should have left earlier (no lo hice). Crítica: You shouldn't have shouted (lo hiciste).
Ought to have significa lo mismo pero es más formal: We ought to have booked in advance.
Could have para oportunidades perdidas o quejas suaves: You could have asked me! Y para agradecer: Oh, you shouldn't have!
es.q: Piensa en una vez en que algo salió mal. ¿Qué deberías haber hecho de otra manera?
es.c: Escribe sobre un pequeño desastre (llegar tarde, perder, olvidar) en cuatro frases con should have, shouldn't have y could have.

fr.q: Pense à une fois où quelque chose a mal tourné. Qu'aurais-tu dû faire autrement ?
fr.c: Raconte un petit désastre (retard, perte, oubli) en quatre phrases avec should have, shouldn't have et could have.

it.q: Pensa a una volta in cui qualcosa è andato storto. Cosa avresti dovuto fare diversamente?
it.c: Racconta un piccolo disastro (ritardo, perdita, dimenticanza) in quattro frasi con should have, shouldn't have e could have.

target.gram: Should/ought to have + past participle: criticism or regret about the past. Should have = it was a good idea but didn't happen.

en.g: Describe actions in progress at a future time with the future continuous.
p: Form: will be + -ing: This time tomorrow, I'll be lying on the beach. At nine, I'll be sitting my exam.
It shows the middle of an action, not the start: When you arrive, we'll be eating (we'll have started before).
Polite questions about plans: Will you be using the printer later? Will you be coming to the meeting?
en.q: What will you be doing this time next week? And this time next year?
en.c: Write four sentences about tomorrow at different times, e.g. At 7 a.m. I'll be having breakfast, with will be + -ing.

de.g: Du beschreibst mit dem future continuous Handlungen, die zu einem Zeitpunkt in der Zukunft laufen.
p: Form: will be + -ing: This time tomorrow, I'll be lying on the beach. At nine, I'll be sitting my exam.
Es zeigt die Mitte einer Handlung, nicht den Anfang: When you arrive, we'll be eating (wir haben schon angefangen).
Höfliche Fragen nach Plänen: Will you be using the printer later? Will you be coming to the meeting?
de.q: Was wirst du genau eine Woche von jetzt gerade tun? Und in einem Jahr?
de.c: Schreib vier Sätze über morgen zu verschiedenen Uhrzeiten, z. B. At 7 a.m. I'll be having breakfast, mit will be + -ing.

Preguntas educadas sobre planes: Will you be using the printer later? Will you be coming to the meeting?
es.q: ¿Qué estarás haciendo a esta hora la semana que viene? ¿Y dentro de un año?
es.c: Escribe cuatro frases sobre mañana a distintas horas, p. ej. At 7 a.m. I'll be having breakfast, con will be + -ing.

Il montre l'action en cours, pas son début : When you arrive, we'll be eating (on aura déjà commencé).
Questions polies sur les projets : Will you be using the printer later? Will you be coming to the meeting?
fr.q: Que seras-tu en train de faire à cette heure-ci la semaine prochaine ? Et dans un an ?
fr.c: Écris quatre phrases sur demain à différentes heures, par ex. At 7 a.m. I'll be having breakfast, avec will be + -ing.

pt.c: Escreve quatro frases sobre amanhã a horas diferentes, p. ex. At 7 a.m. I'll be having breakfast, com will be + -ing.

target.gram: Future continuous: will be + -ing for an action in progress at a future time, or a routine/polite question: Will you be joining us?

en.g: Talk about actions completed before a future point with the future perfect.
p: Form: will have + past participle: By June, I'll have finished the course. By 2030, we'll have paid off the flat.
By means not later than: by Friday, by then, by the time you get here. By the time you wake up, I'll have left.
Compare: At six I'll be cooking (in progress) vs By six I'll have cooked dinner (finished).
en.q: What will you have achieved by the end of this course? And by this time next year?
en.c: Write three goals with the future perfect and by: one for next month, one for next year and one for five years' time.

de.g: Du sprichst mit dem future perfect über Handlungen, die vor einem Zeitpunkt in der Zukunft abgeschlossen sind.
p: Form: will have + Partizip: By June, I'll have finished the course. By 2030, we'll have paid off the flat.
By heißt spätestens: by Friday, by then, by the time you get here. By the time you wake up, I'll have left.
Vergleich: At six I'll be cooking (läuft gerade) vs. By six I'll have cooked dinner (fertig).

en.t: Be about to, be due to
en.g: Talk about very near and scheduled futures with be about to and be due to.
p: Be about to = any moment now: The train is about to leave. I was just about to call you!
Be due to = scheduled or expected: The plane is due to land at 6:15. The report is due on Friday.
Be on the point of + -ing is even nearer and more formal: She was on the point of leaving when he arrived.

en.g: Say who causes an action with get, have, make and let.
p: Get someone to do (persuade): I got Sam to fix it. Have someone do (arrange): I'll have the hotel call a taxi.
Make = force, let = allow, both with the bare verb: She made me apologise. They let us leave early.
Services: have/get + object + past participle: I had my car repaired. She's getting her nails done.

Make = zwingen, let = erlauben, beide mit Grundform: She made me apologise. They let us leave early.
Dienstleistungen: have/get + Objekt + Partizip: I had my car repaired. She's getting her nails done.
